metadata.question: Did Punjab and Haryana have the most amount of active fire detections in 2016 compared to all other years from 2012 to 2024?

data.raw_code: The question is: "Did Punjab and Haryana have the most amount of active fire detections in 2016 compared to all other years from 2012 to 2024?" I need to: 1. Find active fire detection data - MODIS or VIIRS active fire products 2. Focus on Punjab and Haryana region in India 3. Compare fire detections across years 2012-2024 4. Check if 2016 has the maximum count Key considerations: - Use MODIS (MCD14DL) or VIIRS (VNP14IMGTDL_NRT) active fire data - Punjab and Haryana are neighboring states in northern India - Need to define polygon/geometry for both states - Count active fire detections per year - Determine if 2016 has the highest count Data strategy: - Use MODIS Collection 6 Active Fire Data (MCD14DL) which has data from 2000-present - Filter by Punjab/Haryana geometry - Count fire pixels per year using the 'confidence' band or 'FireMask' - Compare 2016 vs other years Potential issues: - If no data for a year -> C1 - If no fire detections in region -> C2 (valid 0) - Need to ensure proper counting of fire pixels Let me structure: 1. Define Punjab/Haryana geometry (bounding box or polygon) 2. Use MODIS MCD14DL collection 3. For each year 2012-2024, count fire pixels 4. Compare counts to see if 2016 is max ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Punjab and Haryana region (approximate bounding box) var punjabHaryana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[73.5, 29.0], [78.5, 29.0], [78.5, 32.0], [73.5, 32.0], [73.5, 29.0]] ]); // 2. Initialize results dictionary var yearCounts = {}; // 3. Loop through years 2012-2024 for (var year = 2012; year <= 2024; year++) { var startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1); var endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31); // Get MODIS Active Fire data var fires = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(punjabHaryana); var count = fires.size().getInfo(); if (count > 0) { // Count fire pixels - use 'confidence' band > 0 var fireMask = fires.select('confidence').gt(0); var totalFires = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: punjabHaryana, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('confidence').getInfo(); yearCounts[year] = totalFires || 0; print(year + ': ' + count + ' images, Fire count: ' + (totalFires || 0)); } else { yearCounts[year] = 0; print(year + ': 0 images, Fire count: 0'); } } // 4. Check for C1 (no data for any year) var hasData = Object.values(yearCounts).some(count => count > 0); if (!hasData) { print("C1"); return; } // 5. Find max year var maxCount = Math.max(...Object.values(yearCounts)); var maxYear = Object.keys(yearCounts).find(year => yearCounts[year] === maxCount); print('Maximum fire count: ' + maxCount + ' in year ' + maxYear); print('2016 fire count: ' + (yearCounts[2016] || 0)); // 6. Determine answer if (maxYear == '2016') { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
